name: River Docks
description: The wooden docks on the edge of Oakhaven. Fisherman Barnaby sits here mending nets and selling bait.
visualTheme: A weathered wooden pier stretching into a slow-moving river, with fishing baskets, drying racks, and seagulls overhead.

history.createdWhy: Built to access the river for fishing and transporting timber logs upstream.
history.majorEvents: Surrendered to a flood five years ago, since rebuilt sturdier.
history.whyExists: Serves as the hamlet's direct link to the river's resources and trade path.
history.currentConflicts: River crabs have grown abnormally large and aggressive, threatening the docks.

ecosystem.weather: Cool mist rising from the water, soft breeze

npcs.name: Fisherman Barnaby
dialogue: A quiet day on the water beats a noisy day in the town.
Mending these nets takes patience, just like catching the big ones.
The River King lurks in the deep waters downstream. Watch your lines.
